messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Poppr version 2.6.0
parts:
Hello all,

I'm happy to announce that poppr version 2.6.0 has officially been released on CRAN and will be available for download on all systems shortly.

As always you can install the new version with the following command:

install.packages("poppr", repos = "https://cran.rstudio.com")

This release includes a new function, boot.ia() and major improvements to the way MSNs are plotted. For details, please see the following blog post: https://zkamvar.github.io/blog/poppr-2-6-0-better-network-plotting/

Cheers,
Zhian

-----
Zhian N. Kamvar, Ph. D.
Postdoctoral Researcher (Everhart Lab)
Department of Plant Pathology
University of Nebraska-Lincoln
